log: LOOP 199  UNDER A FORCED PERTURBATION, DOES ACCESSIBILITY PRECEDE NASCENT TRANSCRIPTION?
PREDECLARED: the matched grid is 10/30/60 min -- THREE points, fewer than the four loop
196 measured as too few for a response time, so no response time is computed here. The
estimator is a cross-lagged panel with the earlier change of the OUTCOME partialled out,
because without that the forward correlation is mostly autocorrelation. Q3 calibrates
the estimator on A549 reduced to three points BEFORE Q4 is read, since a null would
otherwise confound absence with a blind estimator. The vehicle arms are NOT matched to
the grid, so every change is relative to the 10-minute point and no vehicle-corrected
result is claimed.
PRO-seq gene bodies: 60,676 rows x 6 samples
ATAC regions: 56,617 rows x 6 drug samples, 4 vehicle samples (R1_24h_DMSO, R1_5min_DMSO, R2_24h_DMSO, R2_5min_DMSO)

11,049 genes have >= 1 ATAC region within 2000 bp of the TSS
11,001 genes carry BOTH a PRO-seq gene body and a promoter ATAC region
Q1 PASS -- 11,001 joined genes, above the 3000 floor
panel built: accessibility (3, 11001), nascent (3, 11001) (3 timepoints x 11,001 genes)

forward +0.0721   reverse -0.0458   difference +0.1179
Q3 PASS -- the estimator recovers the direction on a series where the lead is known, so a null in Q4 would mean absence rather than blindness
Q4 DOES ACCESSIBILITY PRECEDE NASCENT TRANSCRIPTION UNDER FORCED PERTURBATION?
forward (dATAC 10->30 vs dPRO 30->60 | dPRO 10->30): +0.0357
reverse (dPRO 10->30 vs dATAC 30->60 | dATAC 10->30): +0.1197
difference -0.0840, bootstrap 95% CI [-0.1123, -0.0547] over 2000 resamples
Q4 FAIL -- forcing accessibility to change does not put it ahead of nascent transcription on this clock. Q3 passed, so the estimator can see precedence; this is an absence
Q5 THE STRANGER SWAP
swapped forward -0.0189  reverse -0.0040  difference -0.0149
Q5 PASS -- swapping destroys the association (-0.0840 -> -0.0149), so it belongs to the gene's own promoter and not to the two assays' global time profiles
Q6 WHAT THIS CANNOT SHOW
Three timepoints give exactly one lagged comparison per direction. There is no
response time here, no lag length, and no claim that the precedence is 48 minutes or
any other number -- only its direction.
The vehicle arms sit at 5 min and 24 h and are not matched to this grid, so nothing
here is vehicle-corrected. A drift common to both assays over the hour would look
like neither precedence nor its absence; it would just add noise.
BRM014 inhibits the BAF ATPase globally. A gene whose accessibility changes is not
thereby a gene the drug acted on directly, and this design cannot separate direct
remodelling from downstream consequence.
PRO-seq gene bodies measure engaged polymerase over the whole body, which mixes
initiation with elongation. A change in pause release and a change in initiation are
the same number here.
A pass is about ONE perturbation in ONE cell line. It makes loop 191d's observational
clock more credible; it does not replicate it, and loop 197 established that no
public series can.
